codeReview.summary: The sidepanel listener cleanup is implemented and wired to the existing sidepanel close lifecycle, but the content script change does not actually satisfy VAL-CRIT-003 because its new destroy() method is never invoked. As shipped, the content script still registers a runtime onMessage listener per injection with no corresponding lifecycle path that removes it.

issues.description: ContentScriptHandler.destroy() removes the stored runtime listener, but nothing ever calls destroy(). The file still ends by instantiating the handler anonymously (`new ContentScriptHandler();` at line 100), so the added cleanup path is unreachable and the content-script runtime listener leak remains unfixed.

summary: Fail: the feature only partially fixes VAL-CRIT-003. Sidepanel runtime/storage listeners are cleaned up on panel close, but the content-script runtime listener cleanup is dead code because the new destroy() method is never called.
